description: Shows the account's Press Room orders (one, or the 10 most recent): each item's status (including waiting for brand verification and held for review), live links, due date, delays with their reason and new date, and any replacement offer for an item that could not be published. Use this when the person asks where a press release or an article is. Do not use for reports over a period. Side effects: none; read only.

order_id.description: One order; leave out for the 10 most recent. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: get_order_status
title: Get order status
